crossRefs.note: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.
These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”
They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things, which…
The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is…
You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?
They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are…
For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.

translations.web: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.
translations.bsb: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.
translations.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
translations.asv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full from extortion and excess.
